cause: List comprehension lowering destructured and bound generator variables but did not validate the generator pattern. Binary-key selectors therefore collected values from unrelated headers and could raise on wrong-shaped elements.
fix: Compile the generator pattern with the shared pattern compiler and route mismatch to a self tail-call with the unchanged accumulator. Destructuring, filters and body execute only on the matched branch. Generator variables remain fresh rather than pinned to enclosing bindings.

regression_red.note: Minimal selector rejected no elements on the old compiler. Used the previously rebuilt main/PR81 artifact; generator lowering is unchanged in merged base 09d7a37.

regression_beam.intentional_warning: The shadowed generator variable exercises Erlang generator-shadowing semantics.

cow_http.existing_semantic_comparison: http_merge_request remains request_pseudo_headers, with raw wire_equal false. No comparator/corpus changes in this fix.
